gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-questrial: Refined and spread out, Stentiga opens its tracking wide and gives its crossbars the heft of the stems. Questrial takes over with flat, stencil-cut strokes of a single weight and modern, open rounds.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-radio-canada: Widely tracked letters with crossbars matching the stems in thickness give Stentiga its refined, luxurious, spaced-out look. Stentiga catches the eye; Radio Canada keeps a steady line, curves open.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-radio-canada-big: Radio Canada Big draws a monoline skeleton, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Radio Canada Big fills the line with x-height, a contemporary counterpoint to Stentiga's spread-out, luxurious heading.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-roboto: Bent wire, spaced wide: Stentiga looks refined and luxurious, each letter opening like a door left ajar. And Roboto, a sans-serif with generous round mouths, keeps the drama grounded.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-ruda: Ruda sets a sizable x-height and wire-like monoline strokes beneath the refined, spaced-out Stentiga heading. And its wide-mouthed rounds make page after page of screen reading feel approachable and clean.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sarpanch: Stentiga reads like neon tubing bent into letters of constant thickness, refined and luxuriously spaced. Sarpanch, a sans with a clearly open e and a compact ascender gap, keeps long reading approachable.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Spaced out and luxurious: Stentiga draws its o with sides and top equally thick. Schibsted Grotesk, an approachable sans with big open-looking e and a bowls, makes paragraphs feel easygoing.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sen: Wide-set tracking is the first thing you notice in Stentiga, which feels refined and luxurious. Sen, with a modern constant-weight line and curves that end before turning inward, keeps long reading smooth.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sintony: Stentiga cuts every letter like a stencil channel of constant weight, refined and widely spaced. Sintony, a plain sans with a chunky midzone and smooth curves, sits beside it as the grounded, contemporary partner.
gen-dafont-stentiga-gf-sofia-sans: Spaced wide and luxurious: Stentiga is the refined voice on top. Sofia Sans, modern and unmodulated, has rounded letters with a clearly open side, standing like cut acrylic stencil pieces.
